name: StarRating
description: A row of stars the user clicks to rate something (0..MaxStars).

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The rating shown (0 = no star). Click the stars in the Properties window to change it.

properties.name: ReadOnly
properties.description: True = the user cannot change the rating by clicking.

properties.name: EmptyColor
properties.description: Colour of the stars that are not selected.

properties.name: Shape
properties.description: The figure drawn for every point of the rating.

properties.name: Padding
properties.description: Space inside the control (left, top, right, bottom).

properties.name: ShowValue
properties.description: Write the value (e.g. 3/5) after the stars.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Design-time note shown under the stars in the designer only (not passed to the program).

events.name: ValueChanged
events.description: The user (or code) changed the Value.

events.name: Hover
events.description: The mouse moved over another star (read HoverValue).

methods.name: HoverValue
methods.description: The star under the mouse (0 = none) - read it in the Hover event.
